description: One person - director, chair, CEO, CFO or company secretary - resolved across every ASX board they have sat on since 2018. Name variants ('Geoff Wilson', 'Mr G J Wilson') are joined only on evidence: a shared family trust or super fund in their 3Y notices, or a bio naming the other company (mergeStrength strong); a rare full name alone gives mergeStrength medium. Returns every tenure (role, from/to, fromCensored when first seen after 2018, outcome: current, resigned, retired, takeover with premium, administration, delisted, unrecorded) with its track record - share-price return vs CS200EW (annualised), capital raised, raises and deep-discount (20%+) raises, dilution, guidance given vs beat/in range/missed, the person's own on-market buys and sales - plus a summary, the holding entities that identify them, matchEvidence, possibleSameAs (same name, no evidence: not counted, may be someone else) and otherMatches when several people share the name (pass a personId to pick one). Every tenure carries docKeys. Caveats: records over-weight companies still listed (survivorship) and returns exclude dividends. Suited to 'who is X' and track-record questions about a person. Free.

name.description: The person's name as filed or commonly used, e.g. 'Geoff Wilson', or a personId from another call.
